estate.estateSha256Recipe: sha256 over the document paths in sorted (POSIX separator) order; per file update(path + NUL), update(file bytes), update(one NUL byte)

engine.seam: buildAmnesiacCorpus (src/amnesiac-corpus.js) over perception blocks; merges are induced by rewriting occurrence entityIds at the entity-index layer before the seam

truth.source: fixtures/noisy-estate-manifest.json (the estate answer key; the engine never receives it)
truth.attribution: positional: each raw entity occurrence is matched to the manifest mention at the same document span (blocks located in document text by a first-match-at-or-after-cursor scan); the person set of an entity is the union of its matched mention persons
truth.cleanEntityRule: an entity is world-mappable when positional attribution resolves it to exactly one person AND every person mentioning its surface string anywhere in the estate is that same person; inherently person-ambiguous surfaces never induce a merge and never enter a contamination count

contaminationDefinitions.inducedMixedRecord: a training record (per-block sample or composed sample) in which one falsely-merged identity carries occurrences of >= 2 distinct manifest persons, counting only occurrences of world-mappable entities; inherent pre-merge ambiguity (a shared-surface entity spanning an unmerged collision pair) is excluded
contaminationDefinitions.contaminatedOccurrence: an occurrence of a merged-person entity (a fact about person p) carried in an induced-mixed record: in per-block the record is the block itself; in composed the record is the composed sample rendering that block
contaminationDefinitions.falseIdentityOccurrence: an occurrence of a merged-person entity whose attribution is the false merged identity (per-block: every such occurrence; composed: those rendered into the composed corpus; the difference is content dropped by the hub cap, reported as capDroppedOccurrences)
contaminationDefinitions.corruptionRate: contaminatedOccurrences / cleanOccurrences, where cleanOccurrences counts every occurrence of a world-mappable entity across the whole corpus (identical denominator for both views)
contaminationDefinitions.amplificationFactor: composed corruptionRate / per-block corruptionRate at the same merge rate; when per-block contamination is zero the factor is undefined and reported as null rather than smoothed

mergeDesign.pairSelection: the 20 designed same-name collision pairs (N6) are always merged; random disjoint non-collision pairs are a prefix of one deterministic Fisher-Yates shuffle (mulberry32, seed 20261124) over the eligible non-collision persons, taken as consecutive disjoint pairs; at rate r the ladder adds floor(r * eligible / 2) random pairs
mergeDesign.note: merge rates are world-level person pair rates over the frozen manifest, chosen before any measurement (world-first)

hubDuplication.corpusKind: honest composed corpus (readable identity, composed-v1 policy)
hubDuplication.nearDuplicateDefinition: exact shingle-set Jaccard >= 0.8 over LSH candidate pairs

hub.definition: composed sample truncated by the composed-v1 hub cap (truncatedBlocks > 0)

nonHub.definition: analyzed composed samples not truncated by the hub cap

designedNotRun.title: Entity-degree vs benefit saturation curve (benefit as a function of entity degree k)

design.whatWouldBeMeasured: Closed-book multi-hop recall delta of the composed corpus vs the per-block corpus at matched token budget, bucketed by entity degree k (composed contributing blocks per record: 1, 2-3, 4-7, >=8 = hub-cap-saturated), stratified over the manifest-authored Q1/Q2/Q3 questions whose target person falls in each bucket; the saturation point is the smallest degree bucket after which the composed-vs-per-block delta stops increasing.
design.estate: fixtures/noisy-estate (world-first noisy estate; 60 manifest-authored questions, strata Q1 24 / Q2 24 / Q3 12)
design.armsAndBudget: two LoRA arms (per-block, composed) at the sealed recipe r16/alpha32 with steps/lr from the Stage 4 sweep; degree buckets are an eval-time stratification of the two existing corpora, so no additional training runs beyond the two arms
design.judging: the Stage K3 blinded rubric path with local-judge agreement column, results stratified per bucket and reported verbatim
design.ownerStage: Stage K3 (GPU) owns the trained benefit measurement; the bucketing design above is recorded here so the curve can be executed without redesign

designedNotRun.whyNotRun: CPU-only session; the benefit side of the curve is a trained-model measurement owned by the GPU queue, and this run must not contend with the live GPU job
designedNotRun.note: No number in this artifact comes from the designed-not-run section.

notes: The engine is imported only to construct the corpora under test (perceiveMulti + buildAmnesiacCorpus); no engine module contributes any truth, threshold, or scoring rule.

Blocks built through the { blocks } seam carry no byte-range ids, so per-block sample identity within a configuration is keyed by (source, content); record mapping is asserted unambiguous at build time (no duplicate (source, content) pairs).

Attribution coverage: positional span matching resolves blocks whose content sits verbatim in its document (derived-format reconstructions do not); entity-level person attribution extends to all occurrences of a world-mappable entity, and only world-mappable entities enter merges and contamination counts.

Composed canonical anchors of merged classes are the lexicographically smallest merged surface value (the engine canonical-anchor rule), naming at most one class member; falseNameAnchors reports how often that anchor names exactly one person.

Amplification is quantified on the record-mixing measure, which is where the two views structurally differ: per-block false-merge damage also exists outside this measure (every merged-person occurrence is attributed to a false identity, reported as falseIdentityOccurrences for both views), but in per-block the records themselves stay single-person.

Where the per-block record-mixing rate is exactly zero (the low rates of the ladder) the amplification factor is undefined and reported as null; read the rate rows where the factor exists together with the falseIdentityOccurrences column, so the per-block view is never read as undamaged.
deviations: The K4 handoff line names an open-world estate variant; this run uses the committed world-first noisy estate (spec 2026-11-24) as directed by the K4 work order: it is the committed estate with a spec-authored noise taxonomy and a frozen person-level answer key.

Positional span matching covers only blocks whose content sits verbatim in the document text (derived-format reconstructions do not); coverage is reported in truth.stats, and the induced-merge and contamination machinery is restricted to world-mappable entities, so this limitation cannot inflate contamination.

Hub-cap truncation means the composed view drops part of the contaminated content from the corpus (capDroppedOccurrences); composed contamination rates count only rendered occurrences, so contamination is never overstated by dropped content.
